name: metaphyseal dysplasia, Braun-Tinschert type
description: Metaphyseal dysplasia, Braun-Tinschert type is characterized by metapyhseal undermodeling with broadening of the long bones and femora with an 'Erlenmeyer flask'' appearance, expansion and bowing of the radii with severe varus deformity and flat exostoses of the long bones at the metadiaphyseal junctions.
